title: Sweden grants 25-year rare earths concession - The Northern Miner

facts.claim: The Swedish government granted Leading Edge Materials a 25-year mining lease for the Norra Karr heavy rare earths project.
facts.subject: Swedish government
facts.cause: The company addressed environmental concerns and reduced the project footprint.

facts.claim: The Swedish government revoked a previous Norra Karr concession in 2016 because of environmental concerns.
facts.subject: Swedish government
facts.cause: Environmental concerns.

facts.claim: Leading Edge Materials said it reduced the Norra Karr project's size by 65%.
facts.subject: Leading Edge Materials
facts.cause: To address environmental concerns.

facts.claim: Leading Edge Materials said the Norra Karr project has the capacity to supply all of Europe's annual dysprosium requirements alongside meaningful terbium and yttrium production.
facts.subject: Norra Karr project

facts.claim: A 2021 preliminary economic assessment outlined a potential 26-year mine at Norra Karr producing an average of 5,340 tonnes per annum of mixed rare earth oxides.
facts.subject: Norra Karr project

facts.claim: The 2021 preliminary economic assessment was based on approximately 30% of Norra Karr's inferred resource of 110 million tonnes grading 0.5% total rare earth oxides.
facts.subject: Norra Karr inferred resource

facts.claim: Leading Edge Materials said Norra Karr's dysprosium-terbium to neodymium-praseodymium ratio is 2.5 to 1, or 0.4 kilograms of DyTb for every kilogram of NdPr produced.
facts.subject: Norra Karr project

facts.claim: The 2021 preliminary economic assessment gave the Norra Karr project a post-tax net present value of $762 million, an internal rate of return of 26%, and average annual EBITDA of $206 million.
facts.subject: Norra Karr project
facts.magnitude: $762 million NPV, 26% IRR, and $206 million average annual EBITDA

facts.claim: Leading Edge Materials said it will move Norra Karr toward an updated prefeasibility study and enter talks with potential offtake partners and financiers.
facts.subject: Leading Edge Materials
facts.cause: The mining lease has been secured.
